name: Fidato — Reservation confirmed (email + Drive + WhatsApp + register)

nodes.name: Save PDF to Drive
nodes.notes: The Drive copy stays PRIVATE. Meta gets the file by upload, not by URL, so nothing here needs to be link-readable.

nodes.name: Upload PDF to Meta
nodes.notes:
⚠️ THIS is why Meta Cloud beats a URL header. The file is uploaded straight to Meta and referenced by id, so the voucher is never publicly reachable — no Drive sharing, no public bucket, nothing for a stranger to fetch. Returns { id }, valid for 30 days.

Set META_PHONE_NUMBER_ID in n8n → Settings → Variables, or paste the number id into the URL.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp template
nodes.notes:
⚠️ `name` and `language.code` must match the APPROVED template exactly. A template approved as en_US will fail as 'en' with an error that does not say so.

The two static buttons need no component — only buttons carrying a variable do.

parameters.jsCode:
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESERVATION → BOOKING REGISTER

   Maps a CRS reservation onto the register's columns so the book is one
   book. Reads data.reservation, the second body in the payload.

   ⚠️ fidato_conf_no carries the CRS reference and there is a UNIQUE
   index on it. This node is reached after email and Drive, and n8n
   retries a failed execution — without that index a retry would create
   a second register entry for one booking and inflate every revenue
   figure quietly. A duplicate now fails loudly instead.

   ⚠️ sheet_name is 'CRS', not a spreadsheet tab. That is what tells a
   future Excel import this row did not come from the workbook and must
   not be matched or overwritten by row number.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const d = $('Reservation confirmed').first().json.body.data;
const r = d.reservation;
const rooms = r.rooms || [];

/* One booking can hold several room types; the register has one slot
   per field, so they are joined rather than silently taking the first. */
const join = (fn) => [...new Set(rooms.map(fn).filter(Boolean))].join(', ');

const nights = Number(r.nights) || 0;
const totalRooms = Number(r.totalRooms) || 0;

return [{
  json: {
    fidato_conf_no: r.reference,
    hotel_conf_no: r.hotelConfirmationNumber || null,

    booking_done_by: r.ownerName || null,
    guest_name: r.customerName || null,
    guest_contact_number: r.customer?.phone || null,
    booker_name: r.customerName || null,
    booker_email: r.customer?.email || null,
    booker_contact_no: r.customer?.phone || null,
    company_or_ta: r.companyName || r.company?.name || null,

    booking_date: (r.createdAt || '').slice(0, 10) || null,
    check_in_date: r.checkIn || null,
    check_out_date: r.checkOut || null,

    hotel_name: r.hotelName || null,
    num_rooms: totalRooms || null,
    num_nights: nights || null,
    room_nights: totalRooms && nights ? totalRooms * nights : null,
    occupancy_type: join((x) => (x.adults ? x.adults + ' adult' + (x.adults === 1 ? '' : 's') : null)) || null,
    meal_plan: join((x) => x.mealPlan) || null,

    /* Per-night rate. The register stores a rate, not a total — the
       total lives in total_revenue. */
    room_rate: rooms.length ? Number(rooms[0].sellingRate) || null : null,
    total_revenue: Number(r.totalAmount) || null,

    booking_status: 'Confirmed',
    payment_type: r.paymentTerm || null,

    /* ⚠️ amount_received is deliberately NOT set. Nothing has been
       collected at the moment a booking is confirmed, and writing 0
       would be indistinguishable from a recorded zero payment. */

    sheet_name: 'CRS',
    excel_row_num: 0,
  },
}];

nodes.name: Add to booking register
nodes.notes:
⚠️ Needs the SERVICE_ROLE key, not the publishable one. The register denies anon entirely and has no insert policy, so the publishable key cannot write here — that is deliberate.

Set it in n8n → Settings → Variables as REGISTER_SERVICE_KEY. Both headers need it: PostgREST wants `apikey` and Supabase wants `Authorization: Bearer`.

Prefer: resolution=ignore-duplicates + on_conflict=fidato_conf_no makes a retry a no-op instead of a duplicate or an overwrite.
